problem: Coding agents forget everything between sessions and repeat work and mistakes. Claude-Mem saves notes about what the agent did and gives them back in later sessions.

stack.backend: TypeScript on Node.js and Bun, as a plugin with a worker service and HTTP server
stack.database: SQLite locally; ChromaDB for embeddings; Postgres and Valkey with BullMQ in the optional server-beta setup
stack.ai: Claude Agent SDK with a second observer agent that compresses notes; works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and more; MCP
stack.deploy: npm package (npx claude-mem install), Claude Code plugin marketplace, Docker Compose for server-beta

whatsNew: A second agent watches the session and writes compressed notes, and the next session starts with a short index and loads details only when needed. Memory stays in ~/.claude-mem on your machine.
